name: Bat
otherStatistics: Blindsight 60 ft. Passive Perception 11. Languages none.
appearance: A tiny brown bat with large upright ears, a short muzzle, and wide membranous wings.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 119.
sections.Traits:
Echolocation. While deafened, the bat loses access to its blindsight.
Keen Hearing. The bat has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that depend on hearing.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +0 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The hit deals 1 piercing damage.
sections.At the table: A deafened bat automatically fails ability checks that require hearing.

name: Spider
otherStatistics: Stealth +4. Darkvision 30 ft. Passive Perception 10. Languages none.
appearance: A tiny mottled brown spider with long bristled legs and an ochre leaf-shaped mark on its rounded abdomen.

sections.Printed source: Wizards of the Coast, D&D Basic Rules v1.0 (November 2018), Chapter 12, p. 153.
sections.Traits:
Spider Climb. The spider can climb difficult surfaces and traverse ceilings upside down without an ability check.
Web Sense. While touching a web, it knows where every other creature touching that same web is located.
Web Walker. Webbing does not restrict its movement.
sections.Actions: Bite. Melee weapon attack, +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. The hit deals 1 piercing damage. The target makes a DC 9 Constitution save. On a failure, it also takes 2 (1d4) poison damage.
